'''Combat Unit AZ-02''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by [[Arlaia Zayzen]], a gladiator in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]]. Along with other droids such as [[Medical Unit AZ-01]], [[Advanced Combat Unit AZ-03]], [[Assault Unit AZ-A]] and [[Assault Unit AZ-B]], this droid was designated after Zayzen's own initials and assisted her during the fights. In [[3630 BBY]] Zayzen was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]," who defeated her along with Combat Unit AZ-02 in the first round of the Arena fights.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Combat Unit AZ-02 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as part of the first boss fight of the "Eternal Championship."
